notes:
- Punchy removes every silence: any pause from about a seventh of a second, including the silence at the start and end of each cut and inside screen shares and B-roll.
- Silences are found much better at every pace: the level that counts as silence was set under the room's own background noise on some recordings, so pauses were heard as sound and kept.
- The on-screen text makes sense to someone who has never seen the video: no phrases, nicknames or names that only the clip explains, and no quotation marks.
- Better music: a confident business clip never gets a sad, dreamy or epic song, and a song that ends before the clip is only used when nothing longer fits.
